source:
@@U00372@@
For the present, I bid you—
no, I implore you—
to give me my leave.

@@U00374@@
No, stay another moment, won't you?
Tell me what other news you have.

@@U00376@@
Let me go for now. I'll come back soon.
You can ask me then to your heart’s content.

@@U00378@@
You must admit, I didn’t trap you.
You did it yourself.
Once you've got the Devil in hand,
never let go; it won't be so easy
the second time around.

@@U00380@@
All right, then, if you like,
I’m prepared to stay and keep you company;
but only on one condition:
you'll let me entertain you with my arts
in some worthy fashion.

@@U00382@@
Vd like that. Yes. It’s up to you.
As long as your arts are amusing.

@@U00384@@
Your senses, my friend,
will know more stimulation in this hour
than in a year of academic monotony.
The songs these gentle spirits sing,
the lovely images they bring,
are no mere empty sorcery.
Smell and taste and touch
will be ravished with delight.
No preparation needed, let us begin!
translation:
@@U00372@@
目前，我请求你——
不，我恳求你——
请允许我离开。

@@U00374@@
不，再等一会儿，好吗？
告诉我你还有什么消息。

@@U00376@@
暂时让我走吧。我很快就会回来。
那么你可以随心所欲地问我。

@@U00378@@
你必须承认，我没有陷害你。
你自己做的。
一旦你掌握了魔鬼，
永不放手；这不会那么容易
第二次。

@@U00380@@
好吧，如果你愿意的话，
我准备留下来陪伴你；
但只有一个条件：
你会让我用我的艺术来娱乐你
以某种有价值的方式。

@@U00382@@
Vd就这样。是的。由你决定。
只要你的艺术有趣。

@@U00384@@
你的感官，我的朋友，
在这个小时内会知道更多的刺激
比起单调的学术一年。
这些温柔的灵魂所唱的歌曲，
他们带来的可爱画面，
不只是空洞的巫术。
嗅觉、味觉和触觉
将会欣喜若狂。
无需任何准备，让我们开始吧！
